- 修复部分 Java 环境下中文文件名、路径和工具输出乱码，保留中文证书 Alias 兼容；个别 Windows 签名识别反馈仍待进一步定位，不宣称全部解决。Windows 桌面版需 Windows 10 及以上（64 位）。
- Android 4.4 工控模式支持混合主流 ABI 单包，旧 `armeabi` 须单次确认排除。4.4 仅支持 v7a／NEON，其余主流 ABI 用于 Android 5.0+；用户已用 rc.3 在 4.4／6.0／10.0／11.0 验证其场景。
- 统一壳类名、JNI 绑定与 Manifest 中性字段，收紧 Native 导出和构建路径检查；新核心兼容旧资源，旧核心拒绝新资源，不改变最低 Android 版本、DEXB 或默认加载策略。相关真机 32／64 位、覆盖、缓存、安全策略及 16 KB ARM64 专项通过；新壳未重新完成 Android 4.4 实测。
- 改善用户确认错误报告的有限摘要、执行步骤和环境信息，不上传原始日志或真实路径。另修正服务端活跃去重和统计接口异常，不增加客户端采集内容。

- Fixed garbled Chinese filenames, paths and Java tool output in some environments while retaining Chinese certificate alias support. Some Windows signature-detection reports still require investigation. The Windows desktop app requires 64-bit Windows 10 or later.
- Industrial mode accepts mixed supported ABIs in one APK, with per-task confirmation before excluding legacy `armeabi`. Android 4.4 remains limited to v7a/NEON; other supported ABIs require Android 5.0+. Users validated their scenario with rc.3 on Android 4.4/6.0/10.0/11.0.
- Unified stub names, JNI bindings and neutral Manifest fields, with stricter native export and build-path checks. The new core accepts older resources; older cores reject the new resources. Minimum Android requirements, DEXB and the default loading strategy are unchanged. Targeted 32/64-bit device, upgrade, cache, security-policy and 16 KB ARM64 checks passed; the new stub has not been retested on Android 4.4.
- Improved opt-in error reports with limited summaries, precise steps and environment details, without raw logs or actual paths. Server-side active-installation deduplication and statistics handling were also corrected, without expanding client data collection.
